application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
description:
Rear of Flats
T1-Catalpa
Crown reduction of whole tree by 2 metres to leave a canopy spread of 4 metres. Remove dead and diseases wood.

•	T1 Catalpa is located in the rear of the property as shown on the map provided.
•	The works are part of a regular maintenance program to retain the tree at a suitable size for it’s location.
•	The tree is encroaching heavily onto the roof of the property.

T2-Walnut
Crown reduction of whole tree by 2 metres to leave a canopy spread of 4 metres. Remove dead and diseases wood.

•	T2 Walnut is located in the rear of the property as shown on the map provided.
•	The works are part of a regular maintenance program to retain the tree at a suitable size for it’s location.
•	The tree is encroaching heavily onto the neighbouring property..
